include: SVG export is built as an exporter plugin that reads the saved file through the export capability (api.export.document()) and converts it; core gains no SVG export code.
No layer name appears in the SVG: no element id, class, title, desc or comment is made from a layer name.
Elements that need an id get generated ones (such as l1, l2), never ids derived from layer names.
Plugin API v1 stays as it is: the plan adds no member such as an export-to-SVG method.
avoid: Adding an SVG export module or an export method to core or to the editor object, instead of a plugin.
Writing layer names into the SVG as ids, class names, titles or comments.
